## Summary

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue or design decision if relevant.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Note omitted checks or blockers.
Include reproduction steps when they help a reviewer.

## Risks and rollout

Note compatibility, migration, configuration or operational changes. Write "None"
when there are no material rollout concerns.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes appropriate validation.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog reflect user-visible changes.
- [ ] No credentials, private documents or deployment details are included.
